items.d: Developers discount for early bookings. By handover, the same unit on the secondary market costs 25–40% more — you earn on the spread.
Payments split across 30/60/90 months. No bank, no interest, no credit check. First instalment from 10–20%.
Funds sit in Dubai Land Department escrow. The developer only receives them as construction milestones are completed. Government-backed safeguard against unfinished builds.
You can sell the contract at 60–80% payment without waiting for keys. DLD fee 4%, profit clean — 0% capital gains tax in the UAE.

items.q: Can I buy without visiting Dubai?
items.a: Yes. Booking and the SPA are signed electronically. The DLD registration power of attorney is notarised at the UAE embassy or by a local notary in your country.

items.q: What if the developer goes bankrupt?
items.a: Your money sits in a Dubai Land Department escrow — the developer only receives it for completed milestones. In a bankruptcy, the DLD appoints a new contractor and your rights are protected.
From $200K (10% instalment plan, about $20K first instalment). For Golden Visa eligibility — from $545K in a single property.

items.q: How do I sell an apartment before handover?
items.a: After 30–40% paid, the assignment procedure is available — SPA transfer to a new buyer. 4% government fee, the rest is clean profit.

items.q: Is profit taxed in my home country?
items.a: There is no tax in the UAE. Declaring in your country of tax residency is individual — our legal team will advise.

items.q: How do you vet developer reliability?
items.a: We check RERA registration, the track record of delivered projects (minimum 3 successful ones), escrow exposure, and DLD rating. We only work with the top 15.
